name: Saint Andrew the Apostle
history: A fisherman of Bethsaida, disciple of John the Baptist, and the first apostle called by Christ. He brought his brother Simon Peter to Jesus. Tradition says he was crucified on an X-shaped cross at Patras in Greece, the saltire of Scotland's flag.
fast: The traditional Saint Andrew Christmas Novena begins today: 'Hail and blessed be the hour and moment in which the Son of God was born…', said fifteen times a day until Christmas.
meditation: Andrew's first act as a disciple was to bring someone else to Jesus. Whom will you bring?
prayer: We humbly pray Your majesty, O Lord, that, as blessed Andrew was a preacher and ruler in Your Church, so he may always intercede for us with You. Through our Lord Jesus Christ. Amen.
prayerSource: Collect of the day, Roman Missal of 1962
